verses.text: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
lines: “Who is this who darkens counsel
by words without knowledge?

verses.text: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
lines: Brace yourself like a man,
for I will question you, then you answer me!

verses.text: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
lines: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?
Declare, if you have understanding.

verses.text: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
lines: Who determined its measures, if you know?
Or who stretched the line on it?

verses.text: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
lines: What were its foundations fastened on?
Or who laid its cornerstone,

verses.text: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
lines: when the morning stars sang together,
and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

verses.text: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
lines: “Or who shut up the sea with doors,
when it broke out of the womb,

verses.text: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
lines: when I made clouds its garment,
and wrapped it in thick darkness,

verses.text: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
lines: marked out for it my bound,
set bars and doors,

verses.text: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’
lines: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further.
Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’

verses.text: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
lines: “Have you commanded the morning in your days,
and caused the dawn to know its place,

verses.text: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
lines: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth,
and shake the wicked out of it?

verses.text: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
lines: It is changed as clay under the seal,
and presented as a garment.

verses.text: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
lines: From the wicked, their light is withheld.
The high arm is broken.

verses.text: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
lines: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea?
Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

verses.text: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
lines: Have the gates of death been revealed to you?
Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

verses.text: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
lines: Have you comprehended the earth in its width?
Declare, if you know it all.

verses.text: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
lines: “What is the way to the dwelling of light?
As for darkness, where is its place,

verses.text: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
lines: that you should take it to its bound,
that you should discern the paths to its house?

verses.text: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
lines: Surely you know, for you were born then,
and the number of your days is great!

verses.text: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, or have you seen the treasures of the hail,
lines: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow,
or have you seen the treasures of the hail,

verses.text: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
lines: which I have reserved against the time of trouble,
against the day of battle and war?

verses.text: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
lines: By what way is the lightning distributed,
or the east wind scattered on the earth?

verses.text: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunder storm,
lines: Who has cut a channel for the flood water,
or the path for the thunder storm,

verses.text: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
lines: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man,
on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

verses.text: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
lines: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground,
to cause the tender grass to grow?

verses.text: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
lines: Does the rain have a father?
Or who fathers the drops of dew?

verses.text: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
lines: Whose womb did the ice come out of?
Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

verses.text: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
lines: The waters become hard like stone,
when the surface of the deep is frozen.

verses.text: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
lines: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades,
or loosen the cords of Orion?

verses.text: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
lines: Can you lead the constellations out in their season?
Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

verses.text: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
lines: Do you know the laws of the heavens?
Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

verses.text: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover you?
lines: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds,
That abundance of waters may cover you?

verses.text: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are?’
lines: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go?
Do they report to you, ‘Here we are?’

verses.text: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
lines: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts?
Or who has given understanding to the mind?

verses.text: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
lines: Who can count the clouds by wisdom?
Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

verses.text: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
lines: when the dust runs into a mass,
and the clods of earth stick together?

verses.text: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
lines: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness,
or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

verses.text: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
lines: when they crouch in their dens,
and lie in wait in the thicket?

verses.text: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
lines: Who provides for the raven his prey,
when his young ones cry to God,
and wander for lack of food?
